newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil govt scraps cheque factoring tax plan - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil govt scraps cheque factoring tax plan - paper.

text.p: The Brazilian government has withdrawn from its corporate income tax bill a provision that would have raised taxes on cheque factoring companies and another that would have eliminated meal tickets, a local newspaper said.
Gazeta Mercantil said the provisions were removed in order to guarantee the bill's passage today by Congress' lower house.
The government left in the bill two other controversial provisions it deems essential -- a deduction for poor-performing loans and elimination of the so-called transfer price, it said.
The transfer price allows multinationals to pay less in taxes by underreporting exports and overreporting the value of imports of their Brazilian subsidiaries.
Once approved by the house the tax bill must still be passed by the Senate.
